newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone nearing east coast of South Africa - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone nearing east coast of South Africa - WSC.

text.p: Tropical Cyclone Gretelle is nearing the east coast of South Africa, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Wednesday.
The cyclone, with 75 mph winds, is in the southern Mozambique Channel near 26s/35e, drifting west-southwest.

Gretelle is expected to continue this motion, slowly but steadily weakening during the next 24 hours. During this time, it will be close enough to the northeast coast of South Africa to spread rain squalls into the region, WSC said.
Shipping will be threatened and heavy surf may lead to some flooding along the coast of eastern South Africa and southeastern Mozambique.
